root_cause: ORM migration in PR #4412 removed eager_load(:products) annotation, causing one SQL query per order line item instead of a single batched query (N+1 pattern).
fix_pattern: Re-added eager_load(:products) to Order.with_products scope; added composite DB index on order_items(product_id); added CI integration test asserting max 3 DB queries per checkout request.
detection_signal: p99 checkout latency > 2s + RDS CPU spike to 94%
raw_summary: Payments checkout p99 spiked to 4.8s due to N+1 queries after an ORM migration removed eager loading of products.

root_cause: An ORM migration removed eager loading, causing checkout serialization to lazy-load products one item at a time.
fix_pattern: Restore eager loading, batch product lookups, add query-count regression coverage, and keep supporting indexes in place.
